messages:
tess_cs: Heads-up: prepping a single-slide QBR focused on cost levers for Meridian Health. Need top-10 prompt heatmap, 60/90d burn forecast, and a short renewal ask. Can someone pull prompt-level token split and a simple forecast?

omar_fin: I can do numbers. Will model baseline + 15% opt + reserved-commit scenario. Also include quick $ delta.

kai_prod: I'll query analytics for last 60d and tag prompts as gen vs embed. SQL I'll run: ```sql
SELECT prompt_name, SUM(tokens) as tokens, SUM(CASE WHEN type='embed' THEN tokens ELSE 0 END) as embed_tokens
FROM prod_events
WHERE customer='meridian' AND ts > now() - interval '60 days'
GROUP BY prompt_name
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

usage-bot: ALERT: Meridian at 62% of monthly threshold (threshold=600,000,000 tokens).

tess_cs: Thanks. Kai, flag any prompt >1.2% of total. Omar, aim to have three clear numbers: baseline 90d, optimized 90d, reserve-commit ask. Zara, draft two sentence renewal ask with a pilot offer.

kai_prod: Uploaded CSV to https://internal.redwood/data/meridian-heatmap-2777777777.csv. Top offenders: "patient_summary_gen" 3.2M gen tokens, "index_embeddings" 1.05M embeds, "qa_longform" 1.8M gen. Marked cacheable where applicable.

omar_fin: Draft numbers: baseline 90d ~ $11.2k. With 15% optimization -> $9.5k. 3mo reserved (20% discount) -> effective cost ~$7.6k plus committed runway. Will add calculation notes.

zara_sales: For renewal: "Recommend 3-month reserved commit (20% discount) with an 8-week batching pilot. We can offer a one-time 10% invoice credit if they sign during QBR." I'll paste a one-liner on the slide.

tess_cs: Nice. Ops ask: Kai, can you also export a small anonymized sample of the top 5 prompts (no PHI) for the product team to annotate?

kai_prod: Samples sanitized and uploaded: https://internal.redwood/snippets/meridian-samples-2777777777.txt

usage-bot: SUGGESTION: Add alert rule -> trigger when 3-day rolling avg > baseline * 1.25. Example command: `redwood alerts create --customer meridian --metric daily_tokens --threshold 1.25 --window 3d --notify ops@redwood`

omar_fin: I'll put the cost table and a small sensitivity chart in the slide notes by EOD.

tess_cs: Deadline: Thu 2pm PT for slide drop. I'll assemble and run through with Sales Fri 9am PT. Anything blocking?

zara_sales: No blockers. I'll bring renewal script.

kai_prod: Done with CSV and samples.

omar_fin: Numbers uploaded to slide deck link: https://internal.redwood/decks/meridian-qbr-2777777777 (will update with final ask).

tess_cs: Great work team, closing thread and assembling the slide now :white_check_mark:
